findings.problem: test/preflight.test.mjs imports ../src/preflight/preflight-runner.js, but implementation adds src/preflight/preflight.js; npm test fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND before any preflight tests run.
findings.requiredFix: Provide the canonical preflight-runner.js module (or update the test/import contract consistently) and rerun the focused suite.

findings.problem: PreflightRunner.run() calls store.get(), which returns a frozen projection from freezeChange() without transitionTo(); it then writes change._controllerPreflightResults and calls _persist(). In ESM this throws on the frozen object, so the runner cannot persist results or transition PREFLIGHT→REVIEW.
findings.requiredFix: Use an authorized ChangeStore mutation API that updates the live entity and performs transition atomically; do not mutate the frozen get() projection or expose private state.

findings.problem: Persistence/reopen is incomplete: #load() never hydrates top-level data.preflightResults into #preflightResults, while getPreflight() reads only that map. Persisted controller results therefore disappear after reopening the store.
findings.requiredFix: Hydrate preflightResults during #load or make getPreflight read the durable change-record field, with a reopen test.

findings.problem: ChangeStore.runPreflight() duplicates runner logic, bypasses PreflightRunner, and requires policy.requiredChecks as string names; createPreflightPolicy documents string names while PreflightRunner documents check objects. setRequiredChecks() is ignored by runPreflight(), so host-authoritative per-change configuration does not control verification.
findings.requiredFix: Choose one canonical runner/API and ensure required-check definitions and host-set configuration are used consistently.

findings.problem: ChangeStore.invalidateProof() deletes only the in-memory #proofs entry but #persist() merges disk proofs and has no deletion marker; proof remains durable and will reappear after reopen, so invalidation is ineffective.
findings.requiredFix: Persist proof deletion (or a tombstone/version) and verify getProof after reopen rejects it.

findings.problem: Public ChangeStore.runPreflight does not normalize object required-check definitions. An object policy entry is compared directly to result.name, causing a valid passing check to be treated as missing and failing with `Required checks failed: [object Object]`.
findings.requiredFix: Apply the same string-or-object normalization used by PreflightRunner to ChangeStore.runPreflight, preserving command metadata in persisted results, and add a regression test for the public store path.
